artworks.title: The Falls of the Styx (chromolithograph after Carl Rottmann)
artworks.description: Romantic painters rediscovered the Arcadian landscape Pausanias described: the ruined town of Nonacris, named for Lycaon's wife, and the towering cliff from which the dread water of the Styx descends. The nymph Nonacris survives chiefly as this toponym — the wife whose name the highland settlement bore before the wolf-king's impiety passed into legend.
